cards.hint: Think about everyday items that pick up radioactivity.
options: stainless steel canisters surrounded by concrete
cards.quote: Low-level waste includes items that have become contaminated with radioactive material
cards.stem: What describes the makeup of low-level waste?

cards.hint: Look for the two broad groups named together.
options: pool storage and dry cask storage
cards.quote: There are two broad classifications: high-level or low-level waste.
cards.stem: How is radioactive waste grouped for management?

cards.hint: Think about what happens once radioactivity fades on site.
options: reprocessed to recover plutonium for fuel
cards.quote: either until it has decayed away and can be disposed of as ordinary trash
cards.stem: What can happen to stored low-level waste after it decays?

cards.hint: Recall the pool walls and lining described for shielding.
options: stainless steel canisters surrounded by concrete
cards.quote: These pools are made of reinforced concrete several feet thick, with steel liners.
cards.stem: What materials form the structure of spent fuel pools?
